name: Pending Justifications and Approvals Aging
query:
SELECT
            AW.employee,
            AW.employee_name, 
            AW.company,
            AW.warning_type,
            AW.status,
            AW.approver,
            AW.justification_date,
            AW.approval_date,
            CASE 
                WHEN AW.status = 'Pending Justification' THEN 'Employee'
                WHEN AW.status = 'Pending Approval' THEN 'Approver'
            END AS pending_stage,
            
            CASE 
                WHEN AW.status = 'Pending Justification' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(),AW.warning_date)
                WHEN AW.status = 'Pending Approval' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(),AW.justification_date)
            END AS days_pending
            
            FROM `tabHR Attendance Warning` as AW   
            WHERE 
                AW.company = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(company)s,''), AW.company) 
                AND AW.employee = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(employee)s,''), AW.employee)
                AND AW.warning_date >= COALESCE(NULLIF(%(from_date)s,''), AW.warning_date)
                AND AW.warning_date <= COALESCE(NULLIF(%(to_date)s,''), AW.warning_date)
                AND AW.approver = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(approver)s,''), AW.approver)
                AND AW.status IN ('Pending Justification', 'Pending Approval')
